question: Which superstar accidentally revealed her romance by falling off a bike?
story: Kim Kardashian almost fell off a bike, and that is how the world found out she was dating a seven time Formula One champion. According to E! News, Kim hard launched her romance with Lewis Hamilton on June first, posting a carousel from a New York City bike ride that included the exact moment she nearly went over sideways while taking a selfie with him. The caption was one word. Lately. The rumors had reportedly been building since January, and the two were photographed holding hands outside a Broadway theater in May. Here is where it stands now. Reports say Kim posted a run of couple photos on August ninth, and Hamilton had posted his own the day before, captioned resting, restoring, recharging. He also reportedly credited her by name when talking about his season turning around. Fans have already smashed them into one word. Kimilton.
